title: Domain shear connector base model

sourceOracles.coverage: Indirect ShearConnector normalization through the TecnariaConnector subclass; direct constructor, serialization and error parity are covered by the independent live test

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript ShearConnector classes, including exact unit conversion, JSON serialization, Unicode, inheritance boundaries, cloning and error-path comparisons.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON serialization for normalized connector fields, units and metadata
tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for converted stiffness and resistance values
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The slice preserves the source ShearConnector constructor defaults, explicit-unit requirement, unit conversion, validation order and messages, metadata, serialization and independent instanceof behavior.
TecnariaConnector, TimberDowelConnector, connector catalogs and connector-specific engineering formulas remain outside this bounded slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic solver-neutral shear connector data and unit-normalized properties only; no connector catalog or connection verification is introduced.
